copy.headline: REPLAY: 'Ultimate Dallas Sports Show' streams daily on WFAA+ and KFAA
copy.caption: REPLAY: 'Ultimate Dallas Sports Show' streams daily on WFAA+ and KFAA. WFAA's daily sports show is built for all DFW sports fans, reacting to breaking news and talking top trends for the Cowboys, Stars, Mavs, Rangers and more!
